title: Rainer — Ultradifferentiable extension theorems: a survey
inspection: Relevant full text: Theorem 3.6 and Corollary 3.12.
comparison: Denjoy–Carleman quasianalyticity and cutoff existence are established inputs; compare total weight W_k=k!M_k.

title: Speyer and Wofsey — Characterizing orthants with polynomials (2014 original answers)
inspection: Original arguments read; research forum, not a refereed journal.
comparison: Polynomial orthant-sign parity follows from hyperplane factor multiplicities; close antecedent to FJ’s algebraic lemma.

title: Belotto da Silva and Bierstone — Monomialization of a quasianalytic morphism
comparison: Modification-based monomialization is not literal unit factorization in the original coordinates; theorem-level comparison remains open.

title: Bernardi and Klivans — Directed rooted forests in higher dimension
inspection: Relevant full-text discussion of fitting orientations and discrete vector fields.
comparison: Rooted forests and matching language predate BT; a fitting orientation need not be an acyclic gradient matching.

title: Barmak — On Quillen’s Theorem A for posets
comparison: Contractible inverse images of principal ideals imply simple homotopy equivalence; this is not a literal collapse criterion.

title: Dey, Hirani and Krishnamoorthy — Optimal Homologous Cycles, Total Unimodularity, and Linear Programming
comparison: Boundary total unimodularity and relative torsion are established; BT must contribute the special incidence recognition.

title: Dochtermann and Engström — Algebraic properties of edge ideals via combinatorial topology
inspection: Full relevant text: Proposition 3.7 and its folding proof.
comparison: The chain/Ferrers homotopy dichotomy is already credited prior art, not an independent BT novelty claim.

title: Schumacher and Westmoreland — Modal quantum theory
comparison: Finite-field modal entanglement, no-cloning and nonlocality are established.

title: Schumacher and Westmoreland — Almost quantum theory
inspection: Relevant full-text sections on states/processes and probabilistic resolutions, including §5.3.
comparison: Mixed subspace states and process semantics already exist; strong probabilistic resolution can fail.

title: Abramsky and Brandenburger — The Sheaf-Theoretic Structure of Non-Locality and Contextuality
comparison: Global-section support hierarchies are established; P01’s candidate contribution is its particular chain-ring classification.

title: de Beaudrap — On computation with probabilities modulo k
comparison: Primitive/generic state constraints and uniform complexity differ from P01’s nonprimitive static resources and P02’s exact oracle-query contract.

title: James, Ortiz and Sabry — Quantum Computing over Finite Fields
inspection: Relevant conclusion passage on Deutsch and reversible relational programming.
comparison: Qualitative failure of the usual Deutsch algorithm is prior art; a fully quantified adaptive query lower bound is a narrower question.

title: Diamond and Schumacher — Cloning, deleting, and hiding in modal quantum theory
comparison: Linear independence as the criterion for exact discrimination of pure states is established.

title: Beals et al. — Quantum Lower Bounds by Polynomials
comparison: The polynomial method is established; characteristic-two recorded modal branches require their own contract and proof.

title: Byrne et al. — Density of Free Modules over Finite Chain Rings
comparison: Module structure and coding over chain rings are an existing field; this is a comparison lead, not an exact priority exclusion.

title: Hung and Li — Malcolmson semigroups
inspection: Full relevant text: Definition 3.1 (factorization, triangular erasure and transitive closure); selective neighboring material.
comparison: Matrix comparison is a relevant antecedent; its generated relation must not be silently identified with one two-sided filter factorization.

title: Cummins et al. — Combinatorial Representation of Parameter Space for Switching Networks
comparison: Finite combinatorial parameter regions for regulatory dynamics predate GU.

title: Cummins et al. — Boolean models coarsely sample continuous dynamics of regulatory networks
comparison: A current comparison for Boolean/multilevel regulatory model extensions, not an exact duplicate of GU’s guard-library theorem.

title: Basu, Pollack and Roy — An asymptotically tight bound on the number of connected components of realizable sign conditions
comparison: Semialgebraic sign conditions and cell counts are established machinery.

title: Cheng, Zhao and Xu — Matrix Approach to Boolean Calculus
comparison: Pointwise outer Boolean operations on aligned truth vectors directly precede the numeric CM fusion law.

title: Dubois and Toffano — Adapting Logic to Physics: The Quantum-Like Eigenlogic Program
comparison: Logical truth observables and spectral representations are an established neighboring program.

title: Barbier, Cheballah and Le Bars — Properties and constructions of coincident functions
comparison: Boolean Möbius/ANF transforms and structural identities predate the phase encoding.

title: Unitary and Symmetric Units of a Commutative Group Algebra
comparison: Characteristic-two unitary group-algebra units are a direct comparison area; the abstract alone does not settle the matrix-group count.

title: Erginbas et al. — Adaptive Sparse Möbius Transforms for Learning Polynomials
comparison: Adaptive sparse real-valued polynomial recovery is a current comparator; it is not the same field or access model as IP.

title: Willsey et al. — egg: Fast and Extensible Equality Saturation
comparison: Equality saturation is an established implementation comparator, not evidence that it wins this particular workload.

title: Berkeley ABC — official project documentation
comparison: Logic synthesis and verification provide essential practical baselines for CM compiler claims.

title: Darwiche and Marquis — A Knowledge Compilation Map
comparison: Representation value depends on supported queries, transformations and succinctness; one endpoint must be fixed before benchmarking.

title: Vickers — author’s publications and Topology via Logic description
comparison: Observation-based topology is a mature antecedent to ProLT’s positive-observation interpretation.

title: Bonsangue, Jacobs and Kok — Duality beyond sober spaces: topological spaces and observation frames
comparison: Observation frames are relevant prior art; exact theorem correspondence needs full-text work before a novelty claim.

title: Giles and Selinger — Exact synthesis of multiqubit Clifford+T circuits
comparison: Exact circuit synthesis over Z[1/sqrt(2),i] is established.

title: Amy — Towards Large-scale Functional Verification of Universal Quantum Circuits
comparison: Symbolic path-sum circuit verification is an existing comparator to signed-integral translations.

title: Amy — Complete Equational Theories for the Sum-Over-Paths with Unbalanced Amplitudes
comparison: Exact path-sum equational reasoning is already developed; a new translation needs a specific additional use.
